$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: qc
title: qc.tsv
description: One row per searched file: the headline quality-control number of every QC output, so one table shows a whole run. There is no total row, because a retention-time span and an identification rate do not pool across files. The per-bin detail is in qc.gradient.tsv, the digestion detail in digestion.tsv, and the polymer detail in run-summary.json under qc.polymers.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, as it appears in digestion.tsv and results.sage.parquet.

fields.name: ms1_spectra
fields.description: MS1 spectra read from the file; zero when the search did not need MS1.

fields.name: ms2_spectra
fields.description: Spectra of MS level 2 or above read from the file: the denominator of ms2_identified_pct.

fields.name: rt_start_min
fields.description: First scan start time read, in minutes.

fields.name: rt_end_min
fields.description: Last scan start time read, in minutes.

fields.name: ms1_read
fields.description: 1 when the file's MS1 spectra were read, 0 when they were not. Every MS1 column is zero because nothing was measured when this is 0, not because the measurement was zero.

fields.name: ms1_tic
fields.description: MS1 total ion current summed over the file: each spectrum's stated total ion current, or its summed peak intensity where the file states none. Includes profile spectra, unlike qc.polymers in run-summary.json.

fields.name: psms
fields.description: Rank-1 target peptide-spectrum matches at the q_value threshold.

fields.name: ms2_identified
fields.description: MS2 spectra carrying at least one of those PSMs. Lower than psms where a chimeric search reported several rank-1 PSMs for one spectrum.

fields.name: ms2_identified_pct
fields.description: 100 * ms2_identified / ms2_spectra. With dia.mode = "pseudo" the denominator is the acquired isolation windows while the PSMs come from pseudo-spectra built from them, so this can exceed 100.

fields.name: peptides
fields.description: Distinct target peptide sequences (modifications ignored) among PSMs that also pass the peptide q-value. Not decoy-corrected, unlike digestion_peptides.

fields.name: proteins
fields.description: Distinct protein accessions of PSMs that also pass the protein q-value, which only proteotypic peptides can.

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: Spectrum, peptide and protein q-value threshold every count in this row used.

fields.name: digestion_peptides
fields.description: The `peptides` column of this file's digestion.tsv row: distinct target peptide sequences minus distinct decoy sequences, floored at zero.

fields.name: missed_cleavage_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with at least one missed cleavage.

fields.name: semi_n_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with a non-enzymatic N-terminus only.

fields.name: semi_c_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with a non-enzymatic C-terminus only.

fields.name: non_enzymatic_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with two non-enzymatic termini.

fields.name: top_polymer
fields.description: Polymer carrying the largest share of this file's MS1 total ion current, or `-` when the file's MS1 spectra were not read or no polymer is configured.

fields.name: top_polymer_tic_pct
fields.description: That polymer's percent of the scanned centroided MS1 total ion current, as reported in run-summary.json under qc.polymers; zero when top_polymer is `-`.

fields.name: gradient_bins
fields.description: Retention-time bins this file was split into in qc.gradient.tsv; 10 for a file with spectra, 0 for one without.

fields.name: empty_gradient_bins
fields.description: Bins that acquired MS2 spectra and identified none: a dead region of the gradient, or a spray dropout.

fields.name: min_bin_identified_pct
fields.description: Lowest ms2_identified_pct among the bins that acquired MS2 spectra; zero when none did.

fields.name: max_bin_identified_pct
fields.description: Highest ms2_identified_pct among those bins; zero when none did.
